candidate: Native Women Lead Matriarch Funds borrowers
basis: Lending programs to Native women-led businesses in NM/AZ/CO/UT confirmed (20 creative-fund borrowers; Revolutionary Fund targeting 200 businesses), but no public borrower/portfolio list appeared in results.
caveats: Borrower privacy likely prevents publication; press coverage names occasional businesses only.

candidate: _SUMMARY_
basis: Best finds: IAC's Made/Produced by American Indians trademark directory (indianagfoods.org/producers, 500+ certified producers, state pages) — a true certification-mark dataset; Minneapolis Fed NEED (5,500+ tribally owned enterprises, access model TBD); Native CDFI Network member list plus BIA/NWAF PDF snapshots; NCAIED 40 Under 40 named annual classes; SC state-published Native business directory PDF. Negatives: no IACB registrant list beyond Source Directory, NIBA dormant, no SD/NE Native chamber, Powwows.com Shop Native is noise-level.

candidate: WA Secretary of State CCFS business entity records
basis: SOS FAQ page states the Corporations Data Extract is no longer available; alternative is CCFS Advanced Search with export of result lists to Excel. A data.gov catalog entry for 'Corporations Search (Washington state)' exists.
caveats: Bulk extract discontinued; per-query Excel export only. UBI numbers searchable free, no login.

candidate: WA Department of Revenue Business Lookup dataset
basis: Data.gov catalog entry: Business Lookup covers all current active accounts plus five years of closed accounts for licenses, excise tax accounts, reseller permits; searchable by UBI, name, owners, address; accessible via API.
caveats: DOR licensing data, not SOS corporate filings; complements CCFS for liveness (active/closed account status).
notes: Strong WA liveness signal: active excise/license account implies operating business.

candidate: WA L&I Contractor License datasets (General/Bond/Insurance/Principal)
basis: Four Socrata datasets on data.wa.gov covering contractor license general info, bond, insurance, and principals; downloadable and regularly updated per data.gov/data.wa.gov listings.
caveats: Socrata open data; standard app-token rate limits for API use.
notes: Directly useful for validating construction firms appearing in TERO lists; Principal file supports entity resolution on owner names.

candidate: Oklahoma SOS bulk data (monthly master + weekly updates)
basis: Official bulk order page: monthly export of complete database as tilde-delimited text, 19 relational tables, ~600MB unzipped; weekly update files with same structure; described as paid bulk data services; custom entity lists by type/period/zip.
caveats: Fee-based; pricing not shown in results. File layout docs and sample files published.
notes: Key state for Native-owned businesses; full-database structure supports robust entity resolution.

candidate: Alaska DCCED active business license and corporations downloads
org: Alaska Dept. of Commerce, Community & Economic Development
basis: State GIS portal hosts 'Alaska DCCED CBPL Active Business License CSV File Download'; division site offers downloadable Excel spreadsheets of all licenses on record (100k+ licenses); corporations database searchable with filings viewable.
caveats: License CSV is free; corporations entity database itself appeared search-oriented in results, license file is the bulk artifact.
notes: Critical state for ANC-affiliated and Alaska Native village businesses.

candidate: North Carolina SOS Business Registration data subscription
basis: Data Subscriptions page: Business Registration contract available for purchase; CSV format updated weekly; includes names, addresses, officers/company officials, status, filings list, foreign/domestic flag. Automated scraping of the search UI is not permitted.
caveats: Contract purchase required; pricing not shown in results; no-scrape terms on search UI.

candidate: Minnesota SOS MBLS bulk business data
basis: Official pages: active business data as zipped CSV, refreshed weekly, $30 per request/week for commercial users; news media, journalists, researchers, and non-commercial users may receive the data at no charge; implementation guide with record layout published.
caveats: Free tier requires non-commercial request form; license agreement for commercial use.
notes: Cedar likely qualifies for the no-charge non-commercial channel.

candidate: Montana SOS corporate records bulk data file
basis: Official 'Montana Corporate Records Data File' bulk download spec PDF exists describing comma-delimited, zipped extracts covering corporations, LLCs, LPs, assumed business names; free public search at biz.sosmt.gov. Pricing/access mechanics not in results.
caveats: Spec confirmed but cost and request process unverified; likely fee or subscription.

candidate: Arizona Corporation Commission database extraction (Form M027)
basis: Public records request form M027 allows database extraction including 'copy of entire database' in importable format; database is public record. ACC may deny requests for commercial purposes. Free search moved to Arizona Business Connect (replaced eCorp Jan 2026).
caveats: Manual public-records process, not self-serve; commercial-purpose denial discretion; fees not shown.

candidate: New Mexico SOS Enterprise (SOSE) business portal
basis: Free public search at enterprise.sos.nm.gov (entity name, Business ID, agent, officer; status, filing history). Two searches found no bulk download, API, or open-data dataset for NM entities.
caveats: No bulk channel found; would require direct inquiry to SOS or per-record checks.
notes: Negative result for bulk despite NM being a key state (pueblo/Navajo Nation businesses).

candidate: South Dakota SOS database downloads
basis: Official database-downloads page: databases available for download to the public; request form required; full database downloadable for a fee; quarterly bulk images offered. Free individual search at sosenterprise.sd.gov.
caveats: Fee and request form; fee amounts not in results.

candidate: North Dakota SOS FirstStop data list requests
basis: Records available for purchase, delivered electronically as Excel spreadsheets via FirstStop 'Data List Requests'; ND Login account required. Free single-entity search at firststop.sos.nd.gov.
caveats: Purchase required; fees not listed in results; account signup needed.

candidate: Wisconsin DFI corporate database via ShareFile
basis: DFI Business Entity Data Services offers two datasets: complete corporate database as .txt via ShareFile, and a $5/month feed of entities formed/registered the prior month (.txt and .xlsx by email). Free individual search and annual-report lookup apps.
caveats: Nominal fees; complete-database pricing not shown in results.

candidate: Michigan LARA MiBusiness Registry
org: Michigan Dept. of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs
basis: MiBusiness Registry Portal (replaced COFS June 2025) exposes rich per-entity records free (name, ID, status, resident agent, annual-report standing, full document history); no official bulk download or open-data dataset surfaced in searches.
caveats: Rich per-record data but no bulk channel found; third-party description calls it very open but bulk unverified.

candidate: Oregon Active Businesses / Active Nonprofits datasets
basis: data.oregon.gov hosts 'Active Businesses - ALL' (all active businesses with principal/mailing addresses, registered agent, authorized representative), Active Nonprofit Corporations, and monthly new-business lists; direct download, OData, and Socrata API; regularly updated by the Corporation Division.
caveats: Active entities only; historical/inactive records not in the open dataset.
notes: Best-in-class free state registry access among the 14 target states.

candidate: California SOS bizfile BE bulk orders / Master Unload
basis: bizfile Online offers 'BE & UCC Bulk Orders'; registry of 17M+ records; third-party review describes RESTful API (JSON) plus bulk 'Master Unload' flat/CSV files. LA Times obtained the corp/LLC database via public records request (2018), published on GitHub.
caveats: Bulk orders via bizfile likely fee-based (pricing not in results); PRA request is a proven alternate path; GitHub snapshot is stale (2018).

candidate: OpenCorporates API
basis: Free API access for public-benefit projects (academics, NGOs, journalists, registered nonprofits) by application under an open public licence; paid self-serve tiers £2,250-£12,000/yr at 200-1,000 calls/day; ODbL with attribution and share-alike on combined data.
caveats: Public-benefit grant is discretionary, by application; ODbL share-alike could constrain Cedar's own licensing; per-day rate caps on paid tiers.
notes: Its US registers pages (e.g., OK register 195, MN register 162, ND register 189, CA register 41, AZ register 13) appeared in results, confirming coverage of target states.

candidate: SAM.gov Entity Management Public V2 Extract
basis: GSA docs: SAM_PUBLIC_V2_MONTHLY_YYYYMMDD.ZIP processed first Sunday monthly (all active plus 6-months-expired records); daily delta files Tue-Sat; hosted on SFTP and sam.gov Data Access; separate Entity Management API for record-level queries; includes UEI.
caveats: Public extract excludes FOUO/sensitive fields; already earmarked by Cedar — this confirms exact file names, cadence, and layout PDFs.
notes: Anchor dataset for UEI/CAGE liveness (registration active/expired).

candidate: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File extract (EO BMF) + TEOS bulk downloads
basis: IRS publishes EO BMF as cumulative CSV by state/region, updated monthly; TEOS bulk data downloads page; annual extracts of 990/990-EZ/990-PF financial data; Urban Institute NCCS republishes cleaned BMF.
caveats: BMF keys on EIN, which Cedar's model excludes — matching must run on name+address instead; covers nonprofits/CDFIs only, not for-profit firms.
notes: Validates Native nonprofits, tribal colleges, and CDFI parent orgs as live exempt entities.

candidate: CDFI Fund certified CDFI list
basis: CDFI Fund publishes downloadable Excel list of certified CDFIs (name, location, type, contacts); a Sept 2024 snapshot counted 1,427 certified CDFIs including 64 Native CDFIs; searchable awards database also public.
caveats: Per Cedar rules the 'Native CDFI' designation cannot create/upgrade a Native-ownership assertion — use only to validate existence and active certification of CDFIs.
notes: BIA also posted a 2018 Certified Native CDFIs PDF (bia.gov), now dated.

candidate: Census Annual Business Survey (ABS) AIAN-owned firm tables and API
basis: ABS Company Summary endpoint api.census.gov/data/2022/abscs with owner race variables at US/state/metro level; 2022 reference-year figures reported: 47,519 AIAN-owned employer businesses, $78.5B receipts, 333,153 employees; AIAN firms 0.9% of employer and 1.2% of nonemployer businesses.
caveats: Estimates with suppression at fine geography/industry; counts only — never business-level records; context, not validation.
notes: Historical continuity via SBO AIAN-owned firm reports for 1992/1997/2002/2007 on census.gov.

candidate: Census ABS business-level microdata
basis: Confirmed negative: only tabulated ABS data is public; firm-level microdata is Title 13/26 restricted, accessible solely in-person at FSRDCs with approved SAP application and Special Sworn Status; synthetic public-use microdata is research-stage only.
caveats: Not usable for a registry; listed to close the question definitively.

candidate: Census Statistics of U.S. Businesses (SUSB)
basis: Annual series since 1988; firm/establishment counts, employment, payroll, receipts by geography, industry, and size; downloadable in spreadsheet and comma-delimited formats; US/state datasets 1997-present, MSA from 1997.
caveats: No ownership demographics — denominator/context only (e.g., total firms per county/NAICS to contextualize Native-owned counts).

candidate: Internet Archive Wayback CDX Server API
basis: Publicly documented, no-auth API (web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=...) returning capture records with public fields urlkey, timestamp, original, mimetype, statuscode, digest, length; open-source server; restricted fields need an API-key cookie.
caveats: Informal rate limits; digest field enables change detection but content itself fetched separately.
notes: Exactly fits Cedar's historical-validation need: prove what a directory page asserted on a past date via timestamped captures.

candidate: CSLB Public Data Portal contractor license files
basis: CSLB Public Data Portal offers no-cost downloadable lists (master list of all CA licensed contractors, by classification/county/city/zip); license data split into license master, workers' comp, and personnel files; separate full-file/update-file order form exists.
caveats: Full-file orders via form may carry fees; portal lists are the free path; personnel file supports principal-name entity resolution.

candidate: USAspending recipient data and bulk downloads
basis: Recipient Profiles searchable by name or UEI; award records carry recipient_uei/recipient_parent_uei fields; full API at api.usaspending.gov plus bulk download endpoints for offline analysis.
caveats: Only covers entities that received federal awards; secondary corroboration of UEI + name + activity, not a registry.
notes: Free complement to SAM extracts: an award to a UEI is strong liveness evidence at the award date.

candidate: _SUMMARY_
basis: Best validation stack: SAM.gov Public V2 monthly+daily extracts (UEI/CAGE liveness) + IRS EO BMF monthly CSVs (nonprofits/CDFIs) + Wayback CDX API (point-in-time directory claims) + free state bulk feeds — Oregon Socrata Active Businesses, Alaska CBPL license CSV, Minnesota MBLS (free non-commercial), WA DOR Business Lookup, WA L&I and CSLB contractor files — with OpenCorporates public-benefit API filling search-only states (NM, MI, AZ). ABS/SUSB supply statistical context only; ABS microdata confirmed unavailable.
caveats: Paid-but-cheap tiers: WI DFI, OK SOS, NC/SD/ND subscriptions.
